players.bio: Andrea Natali (born 28 January 2008) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or defensive midfielder for Eredivisie club AZ, on loan from Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen. Natali moved with his family to Spain as a child.

Ayoub Oufkir (born 4 January 2006) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a winger for Eredivisie club AZ. Career Oufkir is a youth product of De Betrokken Spartaan and Sparta Rotterdam. In 2023, he was promoted to Sparta's reserves in the Tweede Divisie. On 16 August 2024, he signed his first professional contract with Sparta until 2027.
Billy van Duijl (born Oct 4th, 2005) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a defender for Eredivisie club FC Volendam.

Calvin Stengs (Dutch pronunciation: ; born 18 December 1998) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a winger for Serie A club Pisa on loan from Eredivisie club Feyenoord, and the Netherlands national team. A product of the AZacademy, Stengs broke into the first team during the 2017–18 season.

Daniël Virginio Deen (born 13 February 2003) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for AZ Alkmaar under 21's.. Daniël Virginio Deen joined the AZ academy at the under-12 level, having previously been with VSV in Velsen. He agreed to his first professional contract with the club in July 2021, signing a two-year contract.
Dave Jacobus Hendrikus Maria Kwakman (born 7 August 2004) is a Dutch footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club AZ Alkmaar.

Denso Kasius (born 6 October 2002) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a defender for Eredivisie club AZ. In January 2021, Kasius joined FC Volendam on loan. On 30 January 2022, he signed for Italian club Bologna. On 26 January 2023, Kasius joined Austrian Bundesliga club Rapid Wien on loan until the end of the season. On 3 July 2023, Kasius signed a 4-year deal to join AZ Alkmaar.
Elijah Raphaël Dijkstra (born 5 August 2006) is a Dutch professional football player who plays as a right-back for Eredivisie club AZ.
Hobie Verhulst (born 2 April 1993) is a Dutch professional footballer who currently plays as a goalkeeper for AZ Alkmaar in the Dutch Eerste Divisie. He formerly played for AZ and MVV Maastricht.
Isak Steiner Jensen (born 23 December 2003) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Eredivisie club AZ Alkmaar.
Jari De Busser (born 21 October 1999) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Dutch Eredivisie club Go Ahead Eagles.

Jeroen Zoet (Dutch pronunciation: ; born 6 January 1991) is a Dutch professional footballer who currently plays as a goalkeeper for Spezia in the Serie A. Having started his career at PSV Eindhoven, Zoet previously played two seasons on loan for RKC Waalwijk before returning to PSV Eindhoven to establish himself as the first choice goalkeeper.

Jerolldino Bergraaf (born 5 July 2006) is a Curaçaoan footballer who plays as a striker. In August 2024, he made his debut for Excelsior. Club career Bergraaf played in the youth of SV Charlois and in his eleventh year he was included in the Excelsior academy. Here he reported to the first team at the beginning of the 2024/25 season. His professional debut followed on August 9, 2024.
Jizz Hornkamp (born 7 March 1998) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a forward for Eredivisie club Heracles Almelo.
Jordy Clasie (born 27 June 1991) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club AZ Alkmaar and for the Dutch national team.
Kees Smit (born 21 January 2006) is a Dutch footballer who plays for Eredivisie club AZ Alkmaar as a midfielder.

Lewis Schouten (born 4 February 2004) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Dutch club Excelsior on loan from AZ Alkmaar. Schouten made his league debut in the Eerste Divisie for Jong AZ appearing as a substitute on 17 January 2022 against FC Dordrecht in a 2-0 defeat at the Stadion Krommedijk.

Matěj Šín (born 2 June 2004) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club AZ and the Czech Republic national team. Club career Šín started his career at local side Polanka, and spent a season with Vítkovice before joining Baník Ostrava in 2014.

Mateo Chávez García (born 12 May 2004) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Eredivisie club AZ Alkmaar and the Mexico national team. Chávez made his professional debut with Tapatío on 29 September 2022, coming on as a 60th minute substitute against Venados. Chávez made his first team, and Liga MX debut on 13 January 2024, in a 1–1 draw against Santos Laguna.

Mees de Wit (born 17 April 1998) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a left-back for AZ Alkmaar. De Wit made his Eerste Divisie debut for Jong Ajax on 25 August 2017 in a game against Fortuna Sittard. He signed for Sporting's U-23 team for the 2018–19 season on 19 July 2018.

Mexx Meerdink (born 24 July 2003) is a Dutch footballer who plays for AZ Alkmaar in the Eredivisie. From Winterswijk, Meerdink was in the youth academy at de Graafschap from 2012 until 2021 when he signed up to Jong AZ. He is the son of former AZ professional footballer Martijn Meerdink.

Peer Koopmeiners (born 4 May 2000) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Eredivisie club Almere City, on loan from AZ Alkmaar. Club career On 17 October 2020, Koopmeiners netted his first professional goal, in a 3–2 away defeat at the hands of Jong Ajax.

Ro-Zangelo Daal (born 10 February 2004) is a Dutch footballer who plays as a winger for Jong AZ and AZ Alkmaar, making his debut for the senior team during the 2024-25 season in the Eredivisie and also playing for the club in the UEFA Europa League. Club career He was born in Amsterdam.
Rome Jayden Owusu-Oduro (Purmerend, 2 July 2004) is a Ghana professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Eredivisie club AZ.
Seiya Maikuma (born 16 October 1997) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Eredivisie club AZ and the Japan national team.

Sem van Duijn is a 22-year-old Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward for Eredivisie club AZ Alkmaar. Known for his work rate and modern style of play, he recently signed a long-term contract extension keeping him in Alkmaar until 2031.

Troy Daniel Parrott (born 4 February 2002) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a forward for Eredivisie club Excelsior, on loan from Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur, and the Republic of Ireland national team.

Valdemar Byskov Andreasen (born 25 January 2005) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a attacking midfielder for FC Midtjylland. Byskov is a youth product of Herning Fremad and Ikast, before joining Midtjylland at the age of 13. On 24 February 2020, he signed his first professional contract with Midtjylland.
Wesley Theodorus Hoedt (Dutch pronunciation: ; born 6 March 1994) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre back for Saudi Pro League club Al-Shabab.

Weslley Pinto Batista (born 1 October 2003), known as Weslley Patati or just Patati, is a Brazilian footballer who plays as a winger for Eredivisie club AZ Alkmaar. Early life Known as just Weslley at the time, he was born in Presidente Dutra, Maranhão, and began playing for local amateur sides.
Wouter Goes (born 10 June 2004) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays for Eredivisie club AZ Alkmaar.
